title: I decent idea, decent functionality, could use more investment in materials
text:
I decent idea, decent functionality, could use more investment in materials. This is a nice little device but it seems a little flimsy. the steel cylinder is thin as is the rubber gasket. It works on the same cylinder gasket idea as a hyperdermic needle. And like most hyperdermic needles, the stopper will pop out of the bottom if you are not careful while moving it down the cylinder. It would have been nice to have some kind of stopper, like a tapered base to the cylinder.

The stopper is soft rubber and it makes a good seal although I filled it with water first to verify that it would. So it does make a decent measuring cup, in fluid ounces anyway. Since it only shows ounces, it's none cocktail uses are somewhat limited. So it's a nice little bar gadget, but not rugged enough to become a heirloom, but functional enough to measure your shots. Not sure that it's worth $10 but good to have in the gadget drawer.
